terra.problem: The verses do not identify the person addressed as His prophet.

The line makes giving themselves to the hungry the only stated condition, but the verses also require removing the yoke, the pointing of the finger, and malicious talk, and satisfying the afflicted soul.

The verses say that the people addressed, not their people, will be called Repairer of the Breach. Being fed with Jacob’s heritage is also conditional on honoring the Sabbath as described in verse 13.
